name: 千原ジュニアの話題沸騰ニュースSHOW
original_name: 千原ジュニアの話題沸騰ニュースSHOW
overview:
A shopping variety show hosted by Chihara Junior!!

We bring you the news that’s causing a sensation not just in Japan, but all over the world!

What’s more, we’ll be introducing these best-selling products at ‘news-worthy prices’!

A string of success stories for those looking to improve their figure!? The much-talked-about EMS machine

Has it turned conventional wisdom on its head!? The best-selling air conditioner

The latest recovery items made from a material hailed as a ‘miracle’

Stay cool just by holding it up!? The parasol everyone’s talking about

Products go on sale to coincide with the programme’s broadcast!
